LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.3: Phonological Awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Phonological Awareness
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is correct pronunciation of words important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. construct simple sentences on various themes
2. apply appropriate pronunciation in oral presentations
3. appreciate the importance of imitation in language acquisition
